name: Aldyar Alarabiya
verdict: Saudi real-estate developer, part of Shahm Holding — the Al-Atawi family's Jeddah holding. Nothing found.
note: Al-Ettifaq front sponsor (2026-27). Its own site still calls Arabian Dyar the 'primary sponsor' of Al-Taawoun and Al-Ettifaq since 2023, but it is gone from Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home shirt in the club's own launch photography (issue #377).
